verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Al-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa lahul-hamdu fil-aakhirati wa huwal-hakeemul-khabeer
Ya'lamu maa yaliju fil-ardi wa maa yakhruju minhaa wa maa yanzilu minas-samaa'i wa maa ya'ruju feehaa wa huwar-Raheemul-ghafoor

Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo laa ta'teenas-saa'atu qul balaa wa rabbee lata'tiyannakum aalimil-ghaybi laa ya'zubu anhu mithqaalu dharratin fis-samaawaati wa laa fil-ardi wa laa asgharu min dhaalika wa laa akbaru illaa fee kitaabin mubeen
Liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati ulaa'ika lahum maghfiratun wa rizqun kareem
Wal-ladheena sa'aw fee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaa'ika lahum adhaabun min rijzin aleem
Wa yaral-ladheena ootul-ilmal-ladhee unzila ilayka min rabbika huwal-haqqa wa yahdee ilaa siraatil-azeezil-hameed
Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo hal nadullukum alaa rajulin yunabbi'ukum idhaa muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeed
Aaftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban am bihi jinnatun balil-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati fil-adhaabi wad-dalaalil-ba'eed
Afalam yaraw ilaa maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum minas-samaa'i wal-ardi in nasha nakhsif bihimul-arda aw nusqit alayhim kisafan minas-samaa'i inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan likulli abdin muneeb
Wa laqad aataynaa daawooda minnaa fadlan yaa jibaalu awwibee ma'ahu wat-tayra wa alannaa lahul-hadeed
Ani-mal saabighaatin wa qaddir fis-sardi wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona baseer

Wa lisulaymaanar-reeha ghuduwwuhaa shahrun wa rawaahuhaa shahrun wa asalnaa lahu aynal-qitri wa minal-jinni man ya'malu bayna yadayhi bi-idhni rabbihi wa man yazigh minhum an amrinaa nudhiqhu min adhaabis-sa'eer
Ya'maloona lahu maa yashaa'u min mahaareeba wa tamaatheela wa jifaanin kal-jawaabi wa qudoorin raasiyaatin i'maloo aala daawooda shukran wa qaleelun min ibaadiyash-shakoor
Falammaa qadaynaa alayhil-mawta maa dallahum alaa mawtihi illaa daabbatul-ardi ta'kulu minsa'atahu falammaa kharra tabayyanatil-jinnu an law kaanoo ya'lamoonal-ghayba maa labithoo fil-adhaabil-muheen
Laqad kaana lisaba'iin fee maskanihim aayatun jannataani an yameenin wa shimaalin kuloo min rizqi rabbikum washkuroo lahu baldatun tayyibatun wa rabbun ghafoor
Fa-a'radoo fa-arsalnaa alayhim saylal-arimi wa baddalnaahum bijannatayhim jannatayni dhawaataa ukulin khamtin wa athlin wa shay'in min sidrin qaleel
Dhaalika jazaynaahum bimaa kafaroo wa hal nujaazee illal-kafoor
Wa ja'alnaa baynahum wa baynal-qural-latee baaraknaa feehaa quran zaahiratan wa qaddarnaa feehas-sayra seeroo feehaa layaaliya wa ayyaaman aamineen
Faqaaloo rabbanaa baa'id bayna asfaarinaa wa zalamoo anfusahum faja'alnaahum ahaadeetha wa mazzaqnaahum kulla mumazzaqin inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin likulli sabbaarin shakoor
Wa laqad saddaqa alayhim ibleesu zannahu fattaba'oohu illaa fareeqan minal-mu'mineen
Wa maa kaana lahu alayhim min sultaanin illaa lina'lama man yu'minu bil-aakhirati mimman huwa minhaa fee shakkin wa rabbuka alaa kulli shay'in hafeez
Qul ud'ul-ladheena za'amtum min doonillaahi laa yamlikoona mithqaala dharratin fis-samaawaati wa laa fil-ardi wa maa lahum feehimaa min shirkin wa maa lahu minhum min zaheer
Wa laa tanfa'ush-shafaa'atu indahu illaa liman adhina lahu hattaa idhaa fuzzi'a an quloobihim qaaloo maadhaa qaala rabbukum qaalul-haqqa wa huwal-aliyyul-kabeer
Qul man yarzuqukum minas-samaawaati wal-ardi quli Allaahu wa innaa aw iyyaakum la-alaa hudan aw fee dalaalin mubeen
Qul laa tus'aloona ammaa ajramnaa wa laa nus'alu ammaa ta'maloon
Qul yajma'u baynanaa rabbunaa thumma yaftahu baynanaa bil-haqqi wa huwal-fattaahul-aleem
Qul arooniyal-ladheena alhaqtum bihi shurakaa'a kallaa bal huwallaahul-azeezul-hakeem
Wa maa arsalnaaka illaa kaaffatan lin-naasi basheeran wa nadheeran wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wa yaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul lakum mee'aadu yawmin laa tasta'khiroona anhu saa'atan wa laa tastaqdimoon

Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lan nu'mina bihadhal-qur'aani wa laa billadhee bayna yadayhi wa law taraa idhiz-zaalimoona mawqoofoona inda rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhum ilaa ba'din al-qawla yaqoolul-ladheena ustud'ifoo lilladheena istakbaroo lawlaa antum lakunnaa mu'mineen
Qaalal-ladheena istakbaroo lilladheena ustud'ifoo anahnu sadadnaakum anil-hudaa ba'da idh jaa'akum bal kuntum mujrimeen

Wa qaalal-ladheena ustud'ifoo lilladheena istakbaroo bal makrul-layli wan-nahaari idh ta'muroonanaa an nakfura Billaahi wa naj'ala lahu andaadan wa asarrun-nadaamata lammaa ra'aw al-adhaaba wa ja'alnal-aghlaala fee a'naaqil-ladheena kafaroo hal yujzawna illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa maa arsalnaa fee qaryatin min nadheerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaa innaa bimaa ursiltum bihi kaafiroon
Wa qaaloo nahnu aktharu amwaalan wa awlaadan wa maa nahnu bimu'adhdhabeen
Qul inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wa yaqdiru wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wa maa amwaalukum wa laa awlaadukum billatee tuqarribukum indanaa zulfaa illaa man aamana wa amila saalihan fa-ulaa'ika lahum jazaa'ud-di'fi bimaa amiloo wa hum fil-ghurufaati aaminoon
Wal-ladheena yas'awna fee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaa'ika fil-adhaabi muhdaroon
Qul inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u min ibaadihi wa yaqdiru lahu wa maa anfaqtum min shay'in fahuwa yukhlifuhu wa huwa khayrur-raaziqeen
Wa yawma yahshuruhum jamee'an thumma yaqoolu lilmalaa'ikati ahaa'uulaa iyyaakum kaanoo ya'budoon
Qaaloo subhaanaka anta waliyyunaa min doonihim bal kaanoo ya'budoonal-jinna aktharuhum bihim mu'minoon
Fal-yawma laa yamliku ba'dukum liba'din naf'an wa laa darran wa naqoolu lilladheena zalamoo dhooqoo adhaaban-naaril-latee kuntum bihaa tukadhdhiboon

Wa idhaa tutlaa alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaaloo maa haadhaa illaa rajulun yureedu an yasuddakum ammaa kaana ya'budu aabaa'uukum wa qaaloo maa haadhaa illaa ifkun muftaran wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lammaa jaa'ahum in haadhaa illaa sihrun mubeen
Wa maa aataynaahum min kutubin yadrusoonahaa wa maa arsalnaa ilayhim qablaka min nadheer
Wa kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim wa maa balaghoo mi'shaara maa aataynaahum fakadhdhaboo rusulee fakayfa kaana nakeer
Qul innamaa a'izukum biwaahidatin an taqoomoo Lillaahi mathnaa wa furaadaa thumma tatafakkaroo maa bisaahibikum min jinnatin in huwa illaa nadheerun lakum bayna yaday adhaabin shadeed
Qul maa sa'altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illaa alaa Allaahi wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
Qul inna rabbee yaqdhifu bil-haqqi allaamul-ghuyoob
Qul jaa'al-haqqu wa maa yubdi'ul-baatilu wa maa yu'eed
Qul in dalaltu fa-innamaa adillu alaa nafsee wa inih-tadaytu fabimaa yoohee ilayya rabbee innahu samee'un qareeb
Wa law taraa idh fazi'oo falaa fawta wa ukhidhoo min makaanin qareeb
Wa qaaloo aamannaa bihi wa annaa lahumut-tanaawushu min makaanin ba'eed
Wa qad kafaroo bihi min qablu wa yaqdhifoona bil-ghaybi min makaanin ba'eed
Wa heela baynahum wa bayna maa yashtahoona kamaa fu'ila bi-ashyaa'ihim min qablu innahum kaanoo fee shakkin mureeb
